markdown:
## Why Candidate Experience Matters

Candidate experience is not just about being nice — it is about business results:

- 38% higher offer acceptance rate
- 55% more likely to refer others (even if rejected)
- 78% of candidates say the experience reflects how a company treats employees
- Negative experiences are shared with an average of 9 people

### The Candidate Journey Map

#### Stage 1: Awareness and Application

| Touchpoint | Best Practice | Common Failure |
|---|---|---|
| Job posting | Clear, honest, salary included | Vague, buzzword-filled, no salary |
| Career page | Authentic, informative, mobile-optimized | Stock photos, broken links |
| Application process | < 5 minutes, mobile-friendly | 45-minute form, account required |
| Confirmation email | Immediate, sets expectations | No confirmation or generic response |

Target : Application should take under 5 minutes. Include a timeline for next steps.

#### Stage 2: Screening

| Touchpoint | Best Practice | Common Failure |
|---|---|---|
| Response time | Within 5 business days | Weeks of silence |
| Rejection communication | Personalized, encouraging | No response (ghosting) |
| Phone screen scheduling | Candidate picks from available slots | Endless email back-and-forth |
| Phone screen experience | Conversational, informative | Interrogation, rushed |

Target : Respond to every application. Rejections deserve communication too.

#### Stage 3: Interview

| Touchpoint | Best Practice | Common Failure |
|---|---|---|
| Interview scheduling | Flexible, candidate-friendly | Rigid, demanding availability |
| Pre-interview prep | Agenda, interviewer bios, what to expect | No information provided |
| Interview experience | Professional, respectful of time | Long waits, unprepared interviewers |
| Post-interview follow-up | Same-day thank you, clear next steps | Silence after interviews |

Target : Maximum 3 interview rounds. Decision within 5 business days of final interview.

#### Stage 4: Decision and Offer

| Touchpoint | Best Practice | Common Failure |
|---|---|---|
| Decision timeline | Commitment to specific date | Open-ended "we will be in touch" |
| Offer presentation | Verbal first, written follow-up | Cold email with PDF attachment |
| Negotiation | Professional, flexible, fair | Adversarial, take-it-or-leave-it |
| Rejection (final round) | Phone call, specific feedback | Email rejection after multiple rounds |

Target : Verbal offer within 2 business days of decision. Written offer same day as verbal.

#### Stage 5: Post-Acceptance (Pre-Boarding)

| Touchpoint | Best Practice | Common Failure |
|---|---|---|
| Welcome communication | Personal note from manager and team | Silence until Day 1 |
| Pre-boarding tasks | Digital onboarding, equipment shipped | Paperwork dump on Day 1 |
| Team introduction | Virtual coffee before start date | No contact until start |
| Day 1 plan | Detailed agenda shared in advance | "We will figure it out when you get here" |

### Measuring Candidate Experience

Candidate NPS Survey (send after every process, including rejections):

- "On a scale of 0-10, how likely are you to recommend applying at [Company]?"
- "How would you rate the following (1-5)?"
- Communication clarity
- Respect for your time
- Interview professionalism
- Overall experience
- "What is one thing we could improve?"

Benchmarks :

- Target NPS: +50
- Satisfaction: >4.0/5.0
- Response rate: >40%

### Quick Wins

These improvements take less than a week and have outsized impact:

- Auto-confirm every application (< 1 hour to implement)
- Add salary ranges to all postings (1-2 hours)
- Send interviewer bios before interviews (template: 30 minutes)
- Call rejected final-round candidates (5 minutes per call)
- Send a Day 1 agenda to new hires (template: 30 minutes)

Our process is designed to create a positive experience for every candidate. Start a pilot .
